text:
laura-sales: Hey team  HelixBank is asking for confirmation on how our ISO27001 scope would cover a 30-day POC. Their security lead wants to know if we can keep the POC completely out of our hosted environment and only use a dedicated/reserved pool or a temporary VPC private deployment.

nathan-iso: Short answer  yes, we can limit the ISMS scope for evidence to the environment used in the POC, but we need to be explicit in the Statement of Applicability (SoA) / scope boundary. If the POC uses Dedicated or Private only, we can provide scoped evidence for those assets.

alex.eng: To add  for Dedicated POC we run on our reserved GPU pool in our infra; logs and telemetry still land in our control plane unless we do a Private deployment. If HelixBank needs zero routing via hosted control plane, Private (VPC or on-prem package) is the safer ask.

priya-se: What exact evidence do they want? Typical asks are: SoA, info security policy, access control procedures, encryption at transit/rest proof, KMS usage, network segmentation diagram, incident response runbook, and subcontractor list.

laura-sales: They listed: SoA, ISMS policy, evidence of KMS integration, data flows for the POC, retention and deletion guarantees, and a short applicability statement saying hosted API is out-of-scope for the POC.

nathan-iso: That should be straightforward. Suggested wording snippet for them to include in the SoA: `"Scope: ISO/IEC 27001:2013 controls are applied to the Redwood Inference Dedicated GPU pool and associated customer-dedicated resources provisioned for HelixBank POC between 2026-05-01 and 2026-05-31. Hosted/shared control plane components are explicitly excluded from this scope; evidence provided covers only the Dedicated/Private deployment and supporting operational processes."`

jamie-cto: Quick ops note  if we exclude the hosted control plane, we must confirm logs/metrics retention for the POC are also scoped. Some customers ask us to purge telemetry after POC. That requires a short runbook and a ticket to engineering to verify deletion.

alex.eng: Agreed. If they want purge we need an engineering change window. For Dedicated POC we can: (1) isolate the tenant, (2) enable KMS-backed keys unique to the tenant, (3) export a dataflow diagram, and (4) run scheduled key rotation / deletion script at end-of-POC.

priya-se: I can draft a one-page applicability statement + checklist of evidence items. Also need to note exceptions: e.g., our code build pipeline and some orchestration components remain company-controlled but can be excluded if no HelixBank data is present there.

laura-sales: Customer also pressed on pricing for a 30-day Dedicated POC with isolation and KMS. Sales wants a quick number we can give them to unblock legal/security.

jamie-cto: Throw an estimated POC fee: base Dedicated reservation + transient engineering support (for isolation & deletion runbook). Suggest: $Xk reserved capacity + $Yk eng time (TBD). Laura  can you capture their expected qps/throughput so we can size GPUs?

laura-sales: Ack  I'll get qps numbers today.

nathan-iso: Next steps from security side: 1) Draft SoA scope snippet and one-page applicability statement (PRIORITY) 2) Produce evidence list and sample artifacts (policies, KMS config screenshots, network diagram) 3) Confirm deletion/purge runbook and sign-off owner. I can own #1 and #2  target EOD tomorrow.

priya-se: I'll draft the applicability statement and a checklist template (so legal/security at HelixBank can tick boxes).

laura-sales: Perfect  thanks all. @jamie-cto @alex.eng please flag any blockers on the engineering side ASAP.

deploy-bot: Deployed snippet: `app: poc-helixbank | env: dedicated-poc | created_by: laura-sales` :white_check_mark:

alex.eng: No blockers on infra assuming we get qps + approval for the temporary keys. If HelixBank wants private VPC instead of Dedicated, engineering lead time is ~2 weeks.

laura-sales: Noted. Will update customer: we can scope ISO evidence to the POC environment, we'll deliver SoA + checklist by EOD tomorrow, and give a POC estimate once they confirm qps.

nathan-iso: Also remember to include a short statement about exclusions: `Hosted shared runtime endpoints are excluded from this POC scope.` That reduces audit confusion.

priya-se: I'll post the draft in this thread when ready.

laura-sales: Thanks team :thumbsup:  I'll keep HelixBank updated and post a follow-up once qps comes in.
